mapper.select: SELECT id, pending_id, run_id, source_component, pending_type, input_mode, status, question, options_ref, answer_schema_ref, continuation_ref, user_answer_ref, created_at, answered_at, expires_at FROM agent_pending_input WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, pending_id, run_id, source_component, pending_type, input_mode, status, question, options_ref, answer_schema_ref, continuation_ref, user_answer_ref, created_at, answered_at, expires_at FROM agent_pending_input WHERE pending_id = #{pendingId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_pending_input SET status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE pending_id = #{pendingId} AND run_id = #{runId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= NOW()
